tips.text: Use the Circuit if Ember is in this week's rotation; it skips the Systems luck entirely.
Bring burst damage that hits the weak spot the instant it opens, like Glaive heavy attacks, the Furis Incarnon or On Call Crew with a Kuva Zarr.
Use Rhino Stomp or Hildryn's Pillage; both work on Ruk despite his invulnerability.
Rank a few damage mods fully instead of running many unranked ones if the fight drags.
Switch to an AoE weapon if weak-spot damage stops registering.
Abort and restart if Ruk stands still and never attacks; his weak spots never open.
Switch to the Circuit if Systems has not dropped after about 100 kills.
Start each component in the foundry as it drops so the 12-hour timers overlap.
Free a Warframe slot before claiming Ember.
Build base Ember even if you plan Ember Prime; Helminth only accepts non-Prime frames.
Keep spare Neuroptics and Systems; they feed Chroma's Neuroptics and the Blazing Step Ephemera.
Nobody calls the farm hard; the complaints are about Ruk's long invulnerable phases.
